description: This file is a PHP web page that provides a user interface for backing up user settings. It includes HTML and JavaScript code, and references other PHP includes for header, userbar, navigation, and footer components. The page allows users to initiate a backup of their settings via a link, and includes a script to check for rebooting status.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Performs an AJAX GET request to 'index.php' to check if the system is rebooting. On success, redirects to login page; on error, retries after two minutes.
